name: @webgrip/ai-skills
description: Webgrip's open-source Claude skills, shipped as a Forgejo-hosted plugin marketplace with per-skill release trains

scripts.check: python3 scripts/check_manifests.py && python3 scripts/sync_marketplace.py --check && python3 scripts/lint_skills.py && python3 scripts/check_opencode_config.py
scripts.test: bash -c 'for t in $(find skills -maxdepth 2 -name test.sh | sort); do bash "$t"; done'
